## Implementation behaviour (implementation truth, never standards law; Q20 has the three layers)

- IB-GPU-LINUX-SERVICE-OFF [PLATFORM_DEFAULT; runtime OBS] Chromium GPU service (Chromium 141.0.7390.37 (9f043f63), headless shell rev 1194): on Linux the WebGPU service is disabled by default, so requestAdapter() answers null without switches; sources CL-IMP-GPU1; explains FACT-CAP-WEBGPU-EXPOSURE, FACT-GPU-ADAPTER-NULL-DEFAULT; stale if browser.flags: Chromium enables WebGPUService on Linux, or the launch switch set changes
- IB-GPU-UNSAFE-SWITCHES [FLAG_GATED; runtime OBS] Chromium GPU switches + Vulkan feature (Chromium 141.0.7390.37 (9f043f63), headless shell rev 1194): FactTest's WebGPU adapter exists only under --enable-unsafe-webgpu, --enable-features=Vulkan, --use-angle=swiftshader, --enable-unsafe-swiftshader and --ignore-gpu-blocklist; every WebGPU admission is bound to that switch set; sources CL-IMP-GPU2, CL-IMP-GPU3, CL-IMP-GPU5, CL-IMP-GPU6, CL-IMP-GPU7; explains FACT-GPU-ADAPTER-SWIFTSHADER, FACT-GPU-ADMITTED-E0, FACT-GPU-KNOWN-ANSWER, FACT-GPU-RELAY-EXACT-E0; stale if browser.flags: any switch of the set removed or renamed at another Chromium revision
- IB-GPU-SOFTWARE-FALLBACK [CONFORMS; runtime OBS] Chromium GPU config + Blink WebGPU + SwiftShader (Chromium 141.0.7390.37 (9f043f63), headless shell rev 1194; SwiftShader 7cd1022; Dawn 9caf493 (source unreachable)): under SwiftShader the WebGPU status is Software and the adapter is a CPU adapter, which Blink reports as isFallbackAdapter: no hardware GPU is involved; sources CL-IMP-DEPS2, CL-IMP-DEPS3, CL-IMP-GPU4, CL-IMP-GPU8, CL-IMP-GPU9; explains FACT-GPU-ADAPTER-SWIFTSHADER, FACT-HARDWARE-GPU-UNAVAILABLE; stale if host.gpu_device_node: a hardware adapter appears (GPU device node) or the SwiftShader/Dawn revisions change
- IB-SAB-CONSTRUCTOR-HOOK [HOST_CHOICE_PERMITTED; runtime OBS] Blink V8 initializer (Chromium 141.0.7390.37 (9f043f63), headless shell rev 1194): the SharedArrayBuffer constructor is installed only where the context may transfer SharedArrayBuffers (cross-origin isolated); sources CL-IMP-SAB1, CL-IMP-SAB2; explains FACT-CAP-WASM-SHARED-THREADS-EXPOSURE, FACT-SAB-GLOBAL-HOST-DEFINED, FACT-SHARED-THREADS-UNADMITTED; stale if origin_security.cross_origin_isolated: the page becomes cross-origin isolated or Chromium changes the hook
- IB-BLUETOOTH-PLATFORM-DEFAULT [PLATFORM_DEFAULT; runtime OBS] Blink runtime features (Chromium 141.0.7390.37 (9f043f63), headless shell rev 1194): WebBluetooth is stable on Android/ChromeOS/iOS/Mac/Win but experimental by default elsewhere: absent on Linux; sources CL-IMP-BR1, CL-IMP-IDL5; explains FACT-CAP-BLUETOOTH-EXPOSURE; stale if browser.product: another platform or a flag enabling WebBluetooth
- IB-SENSOR-EXTRA-CLASSES [EXPERIMENTAL_NOT_SHIPPED; runtime OBS] Blink runtime features + sensor IDL (Chromium 141.0.7390.37 (9f043f63), headless shell rev 1194): Magnetometer and AmbientLightSensor are behind SensorExtraClasses (experimental); sources CL-IMP-BR2, CL-IMP-IDL1, CL-IMP-IDL2; explains FACT-CAP-AMBIENT-LIGHT-EXPOSURE, FACT-CAP-MAGNETOMETER-EXPOSURE, FACT-SENSOR-FAMILY-ADVISEMENT; stale if browser.flags: SensorExtraClasses enabled (flag) or shipped
- IB-DO-REQUESTPERMISSION-UNSHIPPED [EXPERIMENTAL_NOT_SHIPPED; runtime OBS] Blink runtime features + DeviceOrientationEvent IDL (Chromium 141.0.7390.37 (9f043f63), headless shell rev 1194): DeviceOrientationEvent.requestPermission is behind an experimental feature: the specified (at-risk) permission integration is not shipped; sources CL-IMP-BR3, CL-IMP-IDL3; explains FACT-CAP-DEVICE-ORIENTATION-EXPOSURE; stale if browser.flags: the feature ships or is enabled by flag

- IB-RUSTC-PIN-EQUALS-TIP [TOOLING; runtime OBS] rustc wasm64 target spec + platform doc (rustc 1.100.0-nightly 6eeff9a52 (nightly-2026-09-24)): the target spec and platform doc of the toolchain FactTest runs are byte-identical to the tips D15 read: D15's Rust clauses and ERR-001 hold for the toolchain actually used; sources CL-IMP-RS1, CL-IMP-RS2; explains FACT-CORE-ONLY-GRAPH, FACT-WASM64-MODULE-I64; stale if toolchain.nightly.rustc_commit: another pinned nightly
